title: Admin Actions & Advanced Features
description: Create custom actions to perform bulk operations on selected records.

slides.title: What are Admin Actions? ⚙️
slides.content:
Actions are functions that can be applied to a selection of objects in the changelist. For example, you could mark selected posts as published, delete them, or export them as CSV.

Django includes a default action to delete selected items. You can add your own.

slides.title: Creating a Custom Action
slides.content:
Define a function that takes three arguments: `modeladmin`, `request`, `queryset`. Then add it to the `actions` attribute.

```python
def make_published(modeladmin, request, queryset):
    queryset.update(is_published=True)
make_published.short_description = "Mark selected posts as published"

class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    actions = [make_published]
```

quizData.question: What does the `queryset` argument in an admin action represent?

options.text: The selected objects on the page

quizData.explanation: `queryset` contains the objects the user selected in the admin list view.

slides.title: Advanced: Export to CSV
slides.content:
import csv
from django.http import HttpResponse

def export_to_csv(modeladmin, request, queryset):
    response = HttpResponse(content_type='text/csv')
    response['Content-Disposition'] = 'attachment; filename="posts.csv"'
    writer = csv.writer(response)
    writer.writerow(['ID', 'Title', 'Author'])
    for obj in queryset:
        writer.writerow([obj.id, obj.title, obj.author.username])
    return response
export_to_csv.short_description = "Export selected posts to CSV"

class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    actions = [export_to_csv]

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Restrict actions to certain users

You can override `get_actions` in your `ModelAdmin` to show/hide actions based on permissions.
